definition:
နဗ္ဗ

(m.) the sky, This takes the form nabho in cpds, e,g,, nabhogata = existing in the sky.

နဗ္ဗာပန

(nt.) cooling; quenching; extinction.
နဗ္ဗ၊ နမ္ဗ/ဘူ = ယာယနေ-သွားခြင်း၌။ နဗ္ဗတိ၊ နမ္ဗတိ။
nabbho =nābhiyo, nom. pl. of nābhi (q. v.).
nabba/m./the sky. This takes the form nabho in cpds. e.g., nabhogata = existing in the sky.

Bot. the Vallaris solanacea
